caption: All five natural FoldBench proteins with MSA depth <10 (test split). Each dot is one of 100 single-sequence ESMFold2 predictions, converted to a full contact/non-contact map and folded by Helico; diamonds use the ground-truth oracle map. Every map has the same eligible-pair mask and three Helico diffusion samples. Highest pTM selects a sample per map; that pTM also ranks the 101 maps. No ipTM term, clash penalty or map filtering is used. Contact counts may vary. Rank 1 is highest pTM; ties are shown as rank intervals. Vertical jitter only separates points. These 500 decoys represent five proteins.
